title: [EP-V0] receipt.v0 + run.v0: four-axis receipt and hash-linked run ledger, schemas, fixtures
description: CONSUMER: evidence-machine em-1ez (process adapter emits receipts), em-ky5 (ledger/journal). Four independent axes as enums: execution {ok,err,cancelled,panicked}, domain_disposition {positive,negative,refusal,not_applicable}, coverage {unattempted,partial,complete}, claim_state {supported,contradicted,conflicted,unresolved,forced}.
